Last season I put two bags from the cooperative — one DAP and one urea — and the harvest was good, so I will do that again if they have them when I have the cash. I will also spread cow manure because I have animals and it makes the soil soft. I will use my own seed saved from last year, not the new ones from town, because my seed knows this land and I do not have extra money for their bags.
